chapters.goal: Land in Leonida, play the opening, and take the first story trophies.
chapters.name: Landfall
chapters.note: Chapters 1 to 4 follow the story in order; every trophy here unlocks by finishing story missions.

chapters.goal: Push the story through Chapter 2 and grab the two partner trophies while you are paired up.
chapters.name: The Duo Forms
chapters.note: Hot Together and Retail Therapy need your partner beside you, so do them now, not later.

chapters.goal: Clear Chapter 3's missions, including the Cartel Heist.
chapters.name: Vice City, Baby
chapters.note: Three mission trophies in one chapter; keep to the main path.

chapters.goal: Finish Chapter 4 and the final mission's road opens.
chapters.name: Top of the World
chapters.note: The last chapter trophy before the finale; bank the story trophies here.

chapters.goal: Finish the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, and 8 strands in all.
chapters.name: Strangers Across Leonida
chapters.note: Strands appear as the story advances; check the map for new markers between chapters.

chapters.goal: Sample every activity: races, drones, fishing, arcade, bowling, the shooting range, stunts.
chapters.name: Side Hustles & Activities
chapters.note: Try each activity type once for Master of None, then chase the golds and the win counts.

chapters.goal: Sweep the map: meditate at 18 spots, explore 52 areas, find 100 vehicles, card sets and WAiNK spots.
chapters.name: Collectors' Circuit
chapters.note: Do this district by district; most of these counts build while you travel for other trophies.

chapters.goal: Heists, heat and money: vaults, trucks, gangs, laundering, garages, and the odd one-offs.
chapters.name: Heists & Heat
chapters.note: Most of the missable flags live here. Read each guide before you start its job.

chapters.goal: Mop up, reach 100% completion, and the platinum pops.
chapters.name: The Long Road to Platinum
chapters.note: By now only the 100% trophy should be left. Check the in-game stats for the last short category.
